meta.title: x/tools/gopls: stale embed diagnostics when preceded by const block
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@d529aec52f04 (internal/lsp/cache: parse files with ParseFull mode to check if metadata reload is required; CL 339469)
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with the local Go (go1.27.1), which builds both; the server runs the local go command, whose go list reports the embed pattern error. v0.7.1 was tagged 2021-08-02, the fix merged 2021-08-06, v0.7.2 was tagged 2021-09-08.
meta.notes: gopls decided whether a change needs a metadata reload (go list) from an imports-only parse; a //go:embed directive after other declarations (the const block) was not seen by that parse, so editing the directive did not re-run go list and the go list error 'pattern *.txt: no matching files found' stayed. The fix parses the file fully for that check.

settings_note: The issue names no settings (the reporter used govim's defaults).

files.source: issue body, second txtar (the failing one), section '-- main.go --'
issue body, second txtar, section '-- dir/file.txt --' (empty)
issue body, second txtar, section '-- dir/other.go --' (empty)

files.note: a module around the txtar (the reporter's log shows the package loaded by go list in a temporary directory); go 1.16, the release that added //go:embed

repro.steps: Open main.go: go list reports 'pattern *.txt: no matching files found' on the //go:embed line (line 8). Fix the directive by typing 'dir/' before '*.txt', as in the reporter's log bad_part1.log (four whole-line didChange edits: d, di, dir, dir/). Reported: the diagnostic does not disappear. Probe: the diagnostics of main.go after the edits are compared with a fresh session on the fixed text (the reporter's restart, after which the diagnostic is gone) and a fresh control.
